title: Customer Services Administrator
description:
Customer Service Administrator - Temporary Role

Location: Bedford - Fully Office Based
Pay Rate: 14.22 per hour
Contract: Starting Monday 21st September, on an ongoing basis
Hours: 7:30am-4:30pm, Monday to Friday

Are you an experienced Customer Service Administrator looking for a new challenge? We're recruiting on behalf of an excellent business based in Bedford that needs some temporary team members to support their busy operation.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a friendly and approachable team where your skills will make a real impact. You'll play a key role in clearing a backlog and ensuring smooth processes for customers and internal teams.

What you'll be doing:
- Rebooking engineer visits when appointments are cancelled or technicians are unable to attend.
- Transferring data from an old system to a new platform following a major IT integration.
- Managing high-volume administrative tasks with accuracy and attention to detail.
- Resolving invoicing issues and supporting complaint handling where needed.
- Working with Salesforce and other systems to keep everything running smoothly.

What we're looking for:
- Strong Customer Service and Administration skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage a high workload.
- Confident learning new systems quickly salesforce experience desired but not essential.
- A proactive, team-focused attitude.

Interested? Apply today and we will be in contact to discuss the next steps of your application.

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Graduate Town Planner
description:
Graduate Planner

Bedford

Permanent

Our client, an established planning consultancy is urgently looking to appoint an ambitious Graduate Town Planner to work as part of their established team in Bedford. The successful Graduate Town Planner will be working alongside Senior Planners to deliver planning applications, appeals and site assessments for predominantly residential, rural, mixed use and commercial schemes.

For this role candidates are sought with:
- A relevant town planning/ related degree and ideally a further MSc
- An ambition to purse Chartered Planner status
- Some town planning experience
- A full UK drivers licence

Duties:
- Assisting with the preparation and submission of planning applications
- Conducting planning research and policy reviews
- Drafting planning statements, appraisals and appeal documents
- Liaising with local authorities and statutory bodies
- Supporting public consultation and stakeholder engagement activities
- Assisting with client relationship management
- Delivering advice to clients

Benefits:
- Joining an established company with excellent career progression opportunities
- Competitive starting salary and benefits package

Interested? To discuss this vacancy and other positions within the town planning sector, please do not hesitate to contact HARRIET ROIGE on (phone number removed) or email your CV to (url removed) and we will get back to you.

title: Receptionist
description:
Temporary Receptionist

Location: Bedfordshire

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a receptionist to join their team on a short term temporary basis. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys being the first point of contact for visitors and clients. As a Receptionist, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of the reception area and providing exceptional service to all visitors.

Responsibilities:
- Open and close reception, ensuring the front-of-house area is well presented.
- Greet visitors, answer phones, and manage reception email inboxes.
- Coordinate meeting rooms, including bookings, set-up, signage, and refreshments.
- Sort and distribute post, and manage stationery and office supplies.
- Liaise with facilities and suppliers to support the smooth running of the office.
- Provide administrative support to the events and facilities teams, assisting with ad hoc tasks as required.

Skills and experience:
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a professional approach.
- Highly organised, flexible, and able to manage multiple priorities.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and conducting internet research.
- Strong team player with the ability to work independently and use initiative.
- Excellent attention to detail with high standards of work.
- Reliable, punctual, resourceful, and helpful, with a full UK driving licence.

title: Ward Clerk
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Ward Clerk at Bedford Hospital. You will have interaction with patients and relatives as well as staff based at Bedford Hospital. You will be an organised, efficient and motivated individual who is trustworthy and reliable. You must be able to be adaptable within your work role to support the team in all aspects of ward administrative cover.This is an exciting team that will give you the opportunity to grow and develop. The team consists of ward clerks and receptionists that work together sharing their knowledge and experience. Although we have a very strong learning and development function, we appreciate you will need to have acquired some skills and experience from your career in order for your time with us to be a real success. These can be found in the Person and Job Description attachment on NHS Jobs. However we have highlighted some of them below. Educated to GSCE standard or equivalent Experience of working in a customer facing/reception role Experience of using IT package An exciting opportunity has arisen for a ward clerk at Bedford Hospital. To provide both a front line clerical service to clinical staff within the ward whilst also providing "front door" style support to patients and relatives during visits. The post holder will also be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely inputting of patient level data into the relevant clinical systems for the capturing of admission, discharge and transfer of patients. This is to be done whilst also strictly adhering to trust data quality, health records and information governance policies. It is expected that the post-holder will manage their workload in an effective and efficient way and have a flexible approach to covering various wards and the role as it continues to develop with the ever changing needs of the business. The Ward Clerk provides essential administrative and communication support within the ward, acting as a key point of contact for Trust staff, patients and relatives. The post holder will help facilitate effective communication and contribute to the smooth day-to-day running of the ward, ensuring a professional and responsive service at all times. The role is responsible for maintaining accurate records of all patient admissions and discharges, including Hospital Numbers, follow-up appointments, movement of notes and other patient information. The post holder will also update and maintain patient information on Trust IT systems, ensuring all admission, discharge and patient records are accurate and up to date. Duties include, but are not limited to: To update IT systems, including: Admissions Discharges Updating patient details, including correct address, GP details, and next of kin information. To ensure that patients are admitted under the correct Consultant. To file admission packs for new patients in accordance with admission pack filing procedures. To ensure ward trolleys are prepared and ready for Ward Rounds, including ensuring continuation sheets and labels are available for all inpatients. To make follow-up appointments for discharged patients. To file discharge episodes in accordance with discharge filing procedures. In the case of deceased patients, to ensure the correct paperwork is printed for the Bereavement Office and that the GP is contacted. To continually monitor IT systems throughout the working day for any changes in patient status. To support Ward staff in dealing with telephone enquiries. To sort and distribute mail, including re-addressing mail for discharged patients. To report any faults, required repairs, or faulty equipment to the Facilities Help Desk and Clinical Engineering Department. To order non-stock equipment and stationery from Lyreco/ADB, maintaining minimal stock levels in line with next-day delivery availability. To induct and train new members of staff. To carry out any reasonable requests made by the Discharge Officer and Ward staff. The post holder will be expected to undertake all duties in a professional manner, contributing to the effective day-to-day running of the ward and supporting the delivery of high-quality patient care.
